description: Na₄SnO₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent SnO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.37 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to five O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with three NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent SnO₄ tetrahedra, edges with five NaO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one SnO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.54 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to five O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one SnO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five NaO₄ tetrahedra, edges with five NaO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.58 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent SnO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaO₅ square pyramids. There are three shorter (2.29 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond length. Sn⁴⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form SnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-1.98 Å. There are four inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Sn⁴⁺ atom to form ONa₅Sn octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Sn octahedra, corners with six equivalent ONa₃Sn tetrahedra, and edges with six ONa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-13°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Sn⁴⁺ atom to form ONa₅Sn octahedra that share corners with four ONa₅Sn octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Sn tetrahedra, and edges with eight ONa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-24°. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Sn⁴⁺ atom to form distorted ONa₅Sn octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Sn octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Sn tetrahedra, and edges with nine ONa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-24°. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Sn⁴⁺ atom to form ONa₃Sn tetrahedra that share corners with ten ONa₅Sn octahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Sn tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-66°.
